overall_assessment: Two distinct output regimes: the 8 random controls (LR/LH praksis, MG1/MG2 subject courses) split reasonably, but all 20 suspects (teacher-education PEL / Norwegian MG courses) are badly broken: learning_outcomes becomes a 10-30k char blob containing metadata, the reading list and the course-list tail, while assessment receives stray learning outcomes (Generell kompetanse) and often reading-list text. The reading_list row is only the boilerplate heading 'Emnet inngår i følgende studier', so reading lists are effectively lost for these courses.

findings.evidence: Click to view interactive reading list in LegantoObligatorisk litteratur
findings.description: learning_outcomes is a 15-32k char blob (flags long,blob) that starts with the plan's front-matter (Emnekode, Studiepoeng, Planen gjelder for, Ansvarlig), runs through Kunnskap and Ferdigheter, then jumps straight into the Litteratur section (course-list lines, Leganto reading-list text). Real learning outcomes, reading list and metadata are merged under one label. In 17 of 20 suspects this pattern holds; the 8 controls do not show it.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The USN shadow-DOM text has an irregular heading/layout order (the Innholdsfortegnelse table of contents repeats the headings, and learning-outcome sub-groups are interleaved with Litteratur), so the splitter in R/extract_sections.R cuts at the first 'Læringsutbytte' hit and fails to cut at 'Litteratur'/'Læringsaktiviteter' for this layout; text between mapped headings is appended to the previous section.
findings.suggested_fix: For USN, drop the Innholdsfortegnelse block and the front-matter (Emnekode...Ansvarlig) before splitting, and add/prioritize heading patterns for 'Litteratur', 'Emnet inngår i følgende studier' and 'Godkjent (av dekan|emneplan)' in R/section_heading_map.R with line-start anchoring so they terminate the learning_outcomes section. Consider a dedicated usn section_strategy that splits on the known USN headings (Faglig innhold i emnet, Læringsutbytte, Læringsaktiviteter, Deltakelse/Obligatoriske arbeidskrav, Vurderingsformer, Litteratur).

findings.description: reading_list contains only the 31-char heading 'Emnet inngår i følgende studier' (the pre-pass boilerplate flag is a true positive) for every blob-affected course, while the actual literature was swallowed by learning_outcomes or assessment. The section is emitted as a row with no real content; the true reading list is lost.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Emnet inngår i følgende studier' is mapped to reading_list in R/section_heading_map.R, so the end-of-page study-programme list is treated as the reading list while the real 'Litteratur' heading is not matched in this layout.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the 'Emnet inngår i følgende studier' mapping to reading_list (map it to an ignored/drop section), and ensure 'Litteratur' (and 'Obligatorisk litteratur') is the reading_list heading; drop rows consisting only of this heading in .clean_sections().

findings.description: assessment rows begin with 'Godkjent emneplan' and then contain the tail of the learning outcomes (rest of Ferdigheter and the whole 'Generell kompetanse' group), followed by the actual exam text, and in some courses also the reading list (course 15: 6966 chars, course 19: 10787 chars with 'In compendium' literature entries and 'Styringsdokumenter'). Learning outcomes and literature are filed as assessment, and learning_outcomes is correspondingly incomplete (no Generell kompetanse).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Same layout misordering as the learning_outcomes blob: the text after the blob cut is attached to the next recognised heading ('Vurderingsformer'), and 'Godkjent emneplan' footer is not removed.
findings.suggested_fix: Fix the splitting order (see blob finding), make 'Generell kompetanse' a sub-heading that stays in learning_outcomes, strip 'Godkjent emneplan'/'Godkjent av dekan ...' footer lines in .clean_sections(), and terminate assessment at 'Litteratur'/'Styringsdokumenter'.

findings.evidence: Obligatorisk aktivitet og krav til tilstedeværelse
findings.description: Praksis courses' teaching_methods begin with the heading text 'Obligatorisk aktivitet og krav til tilstedeværelse' and include attendance/obligatory-activity rules (all praksis is obligatory, sign confidentiality form), which belong in coursework_requirements per the codebook. Other controls (MG1MA4, MG2EN2) place such text correctly.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Heading 'Obligatorisk aktivitet og krav til tilstedeværelse' appears under Læringsaktiviteter in the praksis layout and the heading is not mapped, so its text stays in teaching_methods; coursework_requirements row is missing for these courses.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a pattern for '^Obligatorisk aktivitet( og krav til tilstedeværelse)?$' mapped to coursework_requirements in R/section_heading_map.R (line-start anchored, before the Læringsaktiviteter pattern is applied).
